# doanson44.github.io

> A client-side-first developer utility hub, personal portfolio, and browser playground.

## About

The site is a static GitHub Pages application built with Rust, Leptos 0.7 CSR/WASM, and Trunk. It does not expose a first-party server-side REST API.

## Main areas

- Home: https://doanson44.github.io/
- Tools: https://doanson44.github.io/#/tools
- Markdown Studio: https://doanson44.github.io/#/tools/markdown
- JSON utility: https://doanson44.github.io/#/tools/json
- JWT utility: https://doanson44.github.io/#/tools/jwt
- Base64 utility: https://doanson44.github.io/#/tools/base64
- Games: https://doanson44.github.io/#/games
- CV: https://doanson44.github.io/#/cv
- Socket market-data playground: https://doanson44.github.io/#/socket

The application uses hash-based client routing. Hash routes are navigation targets, not separate server-side resources.

## Agent discovery

- Agent Skills index: https://doanson44.github.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Sitemap: https://doanson44.github.io/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://doanson44.github.io/robots.txt

## Important limitations

- Browser tools are client-side utilities, not remotely callable APIs.
- The Socket page consumes public third-party market data and is read-only.
- No first-party OAuth/OIDC authorization server, MCP endpoint, or protected API is published.
- Do not request credentials, private keys, or production tokens.
- Base64 is encoding, not encryption. JWT decoding alone does not verify a signature.
